headline: Commercial Oil Tanker Attacked by Drone Near Romania's Port of Sulina
summary: A commercial tanker carrying Azerbaijani crew members was attacked by a drone near the Port of Sulina off the Romanian coast. The event highlights growing safety risks for Black Sea maritime shipping.
why: The Black Sea is a major transit route for crude oil and petroleum products moving from Eastern Europe and Central Asia to global markets.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Drone attacks on tankers in the Western Black Sea raise shipping insurance costs and security risks.
